statement: xpadneo's pinned Xbox Series descriptor documentation presents a 283-byte Bluetooth HID example containing a gamepad input report ID 0x01 and a four-actuator output definition under report ID 0x03. This is one upstream-described descriptor variant, not an authoritative descriptor for every Series firmware or a newly validated physical capture.

applicability.revision: standard Xbox Series controller, model 1914, with explicitly labelled older/Elite comparators
applicability.scope: xpadneo docs/descriptors/xbxs.md:3-165; no descriptor bytes or source excerpts were copied. The original example's exact device firmware is not established by the cited header.
